notes: AEAT Manual practico de Renta 2024, Parte 1, Capitulo 14 (Adecuacion del impuesto a las circunstancias personales y familiares), 'Ejemplo 1. Matrimonio con hijos comunes, residentes en la Comunidad Autonoma de Principado de Asturias', printed pages 1213-1215. Matrimonio, tres hijos convivientes de 27 (grado de discapacidad 33 por 100), 22 y 19 anos. The statement fixes BOTH Art. 58.1 / Art. 61 norma 2a income conditions explicitly: 'Ninguno de los hijos ha obtenido rentas, excluidas las exentas, superiores a 8.000 euros anuales ni ha presentado declaracion del IRPF' (L47378-L47379), so every child is eligible and the example isolates the Art. 61 norma 1a prorrateo. CHOSEN FOR TWO PROPERTIES. First, the manual's 'Nota previa' (L47384-L47387) states Principado de Asturias exercised NO normative competence, so the minimo determined under the Ley del IRPF serves BOTH the gravamen estatal and the gravamen autonomico -- casillas 0513 and 0514 carry the same figure and the CCAA-divergence confound is absent. Second, AEAT prints both sides of the prorrateo for the same three children: 4.550 in tributacion individual, each tranche shown as '(50% s/2.400)', '(50% s/2.700)', '(50% s/4.000)' (L47394-L47401), against 9.100 in tributacion conjunta at the full tranches (L47434-L47445). 4.550 is exactly half of 9.100, so the pair is its own anti-tautology proof with an AEAT-printed figure on BOTH sides rather than a computed complement. The conjunta row also grounds the married-unidad-familiar reading: nota (1) at L47450 states 'Con independencia del numero de miembros integrados en la unidad familiar, el minimo del contribuyente es, en todo caso, de 5.550 euros anuales', and the descendientes take full tranches because both progenitores sit inside the one unit (LIRPF art. 82.1.1a), leaving no second entitled contribuyente to prorate with. EXTRACTION HAZARD, DELIBERATELY EXCLUDED: in the conjunta table the 'Total minimo por contribuyente' row renders as 5.500 in the estatal column against 5.550 in the autonomico column (L47432), contradicting both the 'General 5.550' line directly above it (L47430) and nota (1). That is an extraction artefact, not an AEAT figure, and it appears identically in the 2020 extraction, so it is systematic. This fixture grounds ONLY the 'Total minimo por descendientes' rows, which are what casillas 0513/0514 hold; the minimo del contribuyente and minimo por discapacidad rows are out of scope and are not asserted. Amounts are unchanged across 2020-2025 (Ley 26/2014, en vigor 01/01/2015), and the same example is present in the 2020 extraction.
